subject: Mini PoC: extension proposal & packaging options
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@clearspring.ai>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@clearspring.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Mini PoC: extension proposal & packaging options

Hi Lina / Ben,

Quick note following up on our demo and the metrics we saw this week — the ClearSpring team is getting good signal from the prototype but needs a few more real-user runs to validate throughput and latency at scale.

Two asks from our side so we can keep momentum:
- Can we extend the current Mini PoC by 3 weeks (run through Aug 15) to capture the scheduled integration tests?
- If so, we want to present an explicit extension offer with pricing/packaging options (time-add vs credits vs short dedicated window) to make it easy to sign off.

I attached the usage snapshot from the last 7 days (mini-poc-usage-report.pdf) so you have the token/latency breakdown we referenced.

If you’re open to extension, what are your procurement constraints (PO timeline, legal review, max discount thresholds)? Based on prior deals, I sketched three options and will loop in pricing — but want your quick confirmation that we should proceed.

Proposed next step: If you reply OK to an extension, I’ll send a short options summary and an MAP link to confirm milestones.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: mini-poc-usage-report.pdf
From: Lina Park <lina.park@clearspring.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@clearspring.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 11:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Mini PoC: extension proposal & packaging options

Connor —

Thanks for the note and for the usage file. We ran a quick internal sync: engineering is good with an extension so long as it’s scoped (no extra seats) and we get predictable cost. Procurement is the blocker — legal needs standard SSA addendum and finance needs a simple invoice path (PO + one invoice).

Couple specifics from our side:
- Extension length: 3 weeks sounds right, but can we do a hard cap on peak GPU hours per day?
- Discount: our budget lead mentioned we can consider up to 10% off list for a timeboxed extension if there’s a clear conversion credit that applies to license if we convert to paid after PoC.
- SLA: we don’t need enterprise SLA, but please confirm retention settings and logs for the extended period.

If you can send a short matrix of options (time-add vs token credit vs reserved window) with an example invoice amount for our expected run rate, I’ll route to finance.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’d like to finalize this week.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of ML Ops, ClearSpring Labs
lina.park@clearspring.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Mini PoC: extension proposal & packaging options (internal)

Connor —

I drafted three clean options you can send to ClearSpring (attached: redwood-package-options.xlsx). Kept the numbers tight and included an example invoice at their current run rate (~420 GPU-hours/week). Notes below you can paste into the outbound: 

Option A — Time‑add (3 weeks):
- What: Extend current environment for +3 weeks with same capacity plan.
- Price: Flat extension fee = $17,500 (covers up to 1,500 GPU-hours total over the 3 weeks).
- Discount: 5% one-time extension discount.
- Conversion: If they sign an annual contract within 30 days, apply a $5,000 credit toward first-year commit.

Option B — Credit bundle (pay-as-you-run):
- What: Purchase 2,000 GPU-hour credit bucket valid for 90 days.
- Price: $0.095 per GPU-hour effective ($190 per 2,000-hour bucket) — ie. $1900 (edit: math check: see note below).
- Discount: 10% off bucket list for commitment to convert (matches their ask).
- Conversion: Unused credit rolls into committed contract as a conversion credit, pro-rated.

Option C — Reserved short-window (guaranteed burst):
- What: Reserve a dedicated 48-hour burst window during the PoC extension (+24/7 prep) with higher throughput.
- Price: $9,500 for reserved window + per-hour usage at $0.065/hr for additional hours beyond the window.
- Discount: 7% off if they take the reserved window plus conversion credit of $3,000 on annual sign.

Operational bullets to include (they asked) —
- Retention: Logs retained for 30 days by default; we can extend to 90 days for audit at an additional $500.
- Data controls: VPC peering remains same; no data egress changes.
- PO & invoice: We’ll accept PO and issue one consolidated invoice at extension start.

Internal clarifications: I flagged the arithmetic in Option B (bucket price) — that row is intentionally illustrative; we’ll present a corrected per-hour example in the outbound. I also recommend we offer a short MAP (mutual-action-plan) with milestones: integration test window, performance signoff, and conversion decision date.

Attaching the package spreadsheet and a plain-text MAP link (mutual-action-plan-link.txt) for Lina to review.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-package-options.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-link.txt
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@clearspring.ai>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@clearspring.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mini PoC: extension proposal & packaging options

Lina / Ben —

Thanks for the quick clarity. Per Naomi’s note (attached spreadsheet), here are the three tidy options — corrected bucket math included. I’ll keep this short so finance can route it.

1) Time‑add (3 weeks) — $17,500 (covers <=1,500 GPU-hours). 5% extension discount. $5k conversion credit if they sign within 30 days.

2) Credit bundle — 2,000 GPU-hour bucket for $1,900 (effective $0.95/hr after decimal fix). We’ll offer 10% off list for the timeboxed commitment. Unused credit converts to prepay on commit.

3) Reserved window — $9,500 for a guaranteed 48-hour high-throughput window; additional hours billed at $0.065/hr; 7% discount + $3k conversion credit.

Operational notes: logs retained 30d (can extend to 90d for $500), we accept PO + single invoice at start. We will not add seats or change access during extension.

If you pick A/B/C (or tell us a preferred cap on daily GPU hours) we’ll send a 1-page SSA addendum and an MAP link to lock milestones. Once legal OKs the SSA addendum and procurement confirms PO path, we can flip the extension live within 48 hours.

Ping me with your preference and I’ll get the paperwork in motion.

Cheers,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
